description.zh: 用于匹配自定义域名，例如`example.com`会匹配到`a.example.com`与`b.example.com`。
description.en: The domain name that is used to match custom domain names. For example, if you set domainName to `example.com`, the matched domain names are `a.example.com` and `b.example.com`.

description.zh: 分页查询开始的位置。默认值为0。
description.en: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。默认值为500，最大值为500。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 500. Maximum value: 500.

descriptions.zh:
- Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
- 目前每个Project最多只可以绑定一个自定义域名。
descriptions.en:
- Host consists of a project name and a Simple Log Service endpoint. You must specify a project in Host.

- Only one custom domain name can be bound to each project.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-domains --project ali-test-project --offset 0 --size 10 --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
